title: Youth-Led “Kesästartti Väiskissä” Kicks Off the Summer in Oulainen
content: Young people from Oulainen and nearby areas will celebrate the end of the school year in style at the newly renovated Väinölänranta event park, as the Kesästartti Väiskissä event takes over the area on Saturday, May 30. School Closing Celebration Features Artists Chosen by Young People The stage lineup includes an exciting selection of current rap artists. Helsinki-based DAVI is known for his melodic trap sound and several tracks with millions of streams, including Exit, KYSYY, and Rakastunu Gangstaan. Meanwhile, Brakston, emerging from Northern Ostrobothnia, represents the energy of a new generation of rap and has impressed audiences with confident live performances.
